reviewSamples.author: Photo of Junior Gentles
reviewSamples.text: I've used Mike's services a few times and I find him to be punctual, honest, and knowledgeable. He knows his craft, is very thorough with his work, explains the problem so you can understand what is wrong and his prices are very reasonable. I highly recommend Mike's Air & Refrigeration.
